caption_L1: This area diagram is labeled North American box office revenue of 20th Century Fox from 2000 to 2019 (in million U.S. dollars). Box office revenue in million U.S. dollars is plotted on the y-axis. Along the x-axis, Year is drawn using a linear scale with a minimum of 2000 and a maximum of 2015.
caption_L2L3: Around 2014 saw 20th Century Fox's peak revenue gain taking in nearly 1,700 million dollars. The incomes were varied seeing large peaks and drops year on year where revenue was seen at its lowest coming up to the year 2020 after taking a huge loss from 2016 up to this period.
